scientific_integrity: Analytical stationary renewal-age and affine-recursion proof; finite numerical checks supplement rather than replace it. The reset changes the Brownian force, not particle position.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional harmonic confinement; i.i.d. positive renewal intervals; independent Brownian driving excursions; constant-amplitude regularly varying waiting-time survival for the explicit Pareto equivalent. No general nonlinear traps or unstable inverse claims.
title: Pareto positional tails from renewal-reset Brownian forcing in a harmonic trap
